name: clipboard-text-processor
description: 浏览器插件与网页版文本处理工具

scripts.dev: corepack pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter web dev
scripts.dev:extension: corepack pnpm build:core && pnpm --filter extension dev
scripts.build: corepack pnpm run build:core && corepack pnpm run build:web && corepack pnpm run build:extension
scripts.test: corepack pnpm build:core && corepack pnpm --filter core test && corepack pnpm --filter web test && corepack pnpm --filter extension test
scripts.typecheck: corepack pnpm build:core && corepack pnpm --filter core typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter web typecheck && corepack pnpm --filter extension typecheck
scripts.verify: corepack pnpm typecheck && corepack pnpm lint && corepack pnpm test && corepack pnpm build
scripts.package:extension: corepack pnpm build:core && corepack pnpm --filter extension test && corepack pnpm --filter extension build && node scripts/package-extension.mjs
